Exchange Student Information: 
 
 
Visa Nationals of the following countries are exempted in accordance with the 
written instruction of the Chief Executive: 
 
Albania, Andorra, Australia, Austria, Belgium, Bosnia and Herzegovina, 
Brazil, Brunei, Bulgaria, Canada, Cape Verde, Chile, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech, 
Denmark, Dominica, Egypt, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, 
Grenada, Hungary, Iceland, India, Indonesia, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, 
Kingdom of Morocco, Kiribati, Korea (Republic of), Latvia, Lebanon, 
Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Macedonia, Malaysia, Mali, Malta, 
Mauritius, Mexico, Moldova, Monaco, Mongolia, Montenegro, Namibia, 
Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Philippines, Poland, Portugal, Republic 
of Argentina, Republic of Armenia, Republic of Belarus, Republic of 
Ecuador, Romania, Russia, Samoa, San Marino, Serbia, Seychelles, 
Singapore, Slovakia, Slovenia, South Africa, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, 
Tanzania, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, U.S.A., United Kingdom, 
Uruguay 
 
For further information, please visit the link below:  
https://www.gov.mo/en/services/ps-1474/ps-1474b/#6 
Cost of 
Living 
 On Campus Accommodation 
(Utilities-water and electricity included) 
Single Occupancy : HKD8000 per month 
Shared room (2beds) : HKD4500 per person per month 
 Off Campus Accommodation 
- Rent private owner apartment (Two bedrooms) : 
Approximately HKD 15,000-18,000 per month 
 Transportation 
Bus fare: MOP3 for normal lines and MOP4 for the fast lines  
(For Macau Pass holders) 
 Lunch per day 
Approximately MOP 40 
 Dinner per day 
Approximately MOP 50-60 
 Miscellaneous (Water, Phone bills etc)  
around MOP 300 per month 
 Official certificate issued by M.U.S.T. 
HKD 150 per copy 
 
* Amount may vary due to different life style. Fees Incoming students must pay the following fee: 
 Caution fee of HKD 3,000.00 which will be refunded at the end of 
the semester unless they are found liable for any damages to the 
university properties
